file: Aria's Realistic Intelligence Assistance 1.0 — Chibi Edition (Text Completions).json
method: raw-text replacement of json.dumps(old)[1:-1], each asserted once

changes.where: sysprompt.post_history (Logic Core closing sentence, TC-only glue)
changes.old: For a message written as {{user}}, plan only {{user}}'s move, with no Fate, Bonds, Ledger, Layers, Role, Frank, Own words or POV line.
changes.new: For a message written as {{user}}, plan only {{user}}'s move; skip any Fate, Bonds, Ledger, Layers, Role, Frank, Own words or POV line.
changes.why: With the Logic Core on, this sentence stands in for the four gate notes (Own words, POV, Ledger, Layers), but 'plan only ... with no X line' limits only the plan, and Own words and POV are never plan lines, so on an Impersonate turn the gate's Own words, POV and Ledger lines had no skip. 'skip any ... line' covers plan and gate lines alike; +1 character; still ends ' line.' for the Fix 3 regexes.
